covered_actors: data controllers training, developing, or operating AI models using personal data
implementation_notes: This document is a formal procedural request from the Irish Supervisory Authority (IE SA) to the European Data Protection Board (EDPB) seeking an Article 64(2) GDPR opinion on AI models (including large language models). It does not itself impose new binding obligations or issue final guidance; instead, it frames four interpretive questions under the GDPR and Law Enforcement Directive (LED)—explicitly excluding the EU AI Act, DMA, DGA, and DSA—concerning model anonymity, legitimate interests as a legal basis for training and post-training processing, and the downstream effect of unlawfully processed training data.
